tiers.1: real census village polygon, exact name match
tiers.2: real census village polygon of the locality, may differ from the AOI extent
tiers.3: containing/candidate census unit; approximate, not the AOI extent
tiers.4: no boundary data found; 2 km AOI box only

metadata.warning: Only tiers 1-2 are real boundaries. Tiers 3-4 are approximations; do not use their area_km2 as the area of the named place.
